ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across the central 60% of the surface area, contrasted with high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral margins and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black central region extending from the median notch. High-frequency black mottling and stippling overlaid on white base regions along the distal-lateral boundaries, with higher stipple density on the right lobe (image perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation with an approximate angle of 40 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serration along the entire trailing edge; frequency of approximately 18-22 irregular peaks per lobe with variable pixel-amplitude, most pronounced near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral upward-flaring sweep; leading edge exhibits convex curvature while the trailing edge transitions from concave near the notch to convex toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark clusters/protuberances on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating localized surface texture variation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, vertical, high-intensity (white) linear streaks observed on the low-intensity (black) pigment of the right lobe, appearing as distinct scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical tissue irregularities and dark scarring present on the tips of both lobes, likely associated with previous barnacle colonization.
